problem: A missing same-scope bucket returns MANUAL, not FAIL, because the bucket could be in another project; the title presents existence as a definite check.
No matching backend-service attachment returns MANUAL, not FAIL, because a cross-project or non-load-balanced use may be intentional.
No qualifying same-project all-entries sink returns MANUAL, not FAIL, because ancestor aggregate sinks are not joined.
No direct project auditConfigs returns MANUAL, not FAIL, because inherited folder or organization settings are not joined.
Missing direct project DATA_READ or DATA_WRITE settings returns MANUAL, not FAIL, because ancestor audit settings are not joined.
A rotationPeriod at most 90 days with nextRotationTime absent returns PASS, despite the title saying the secret is not overdue and remediation asking for a future nextRotationTime.
The title says a zonal cluster spans at least three zones, but the evaluator only checks len(locations) >= 3; three duplicate entries could PASS without three distinct zones.
